Acquired diseases.condition: Immuno-mediated diseases (rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus, dermatomyositis)

content.Genetic prevalence and diagnostic points: The guideline states gene mutations occur in up to ~40% of DCM, ~60% of HCM, and ~15% in chemotherapy-induced, alcoholic or peripartum CMPs; prevalence of genetic mutations is >10% in non-familial DCM. Echocardiography and CMR are central; endomyocardial biopsy (EMB) with immunohistochemistry remains gold standard for identifying cardiac inflammation.
